es: El resultado no depende de ti.
en: The result isn’t up to you.

verso.es: Tienes derecho a desempeñar tu deber prescrito, mas no a los frutos de la acción. Nunca consideres ser la causa de los resultados de tus actividades y jamás te apegues al incumplimiento de tu deber.
verso.en: You have a right to perform your prescribed duty, but you are not entitled to the fruits of action. Never consider yourself to be the cause of the results of your activities, and never be attached to not doing your duty.
